subset_definition: Pinned official SSDA_MME source-list identity; not the custom PyTorch-Adapt 80/20 split
selection_rationale: Chosen before this work downloads any dataset lists/images or evaluates models: retain the real-photo domain for a fixed art-to-photo test, use the smallest remaining source archive, assign painting/sketch to development/calibration in alphabetical order. No benchmark performance used.
source_membership_gate: Validate the pinned source-list Git blob and new SHA256; decode only listed clipart source images; check all list paths/classes against the downloaded archive. Any incompatibility stops preparation; no archive/list substitution.
license_scope: Official dataset page provides material for non-commercial research/education with a third-party copyright/fair-use notice, not a blanket redistribution license. Raw images stay outside the release.
required_before_source_training: source artifact receipt and complete decoding
reviewed source-only runner and synthetic tests
frozen source training configuration and code identities
